description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: 让远程 Mac 在任意设备上获得原生级体验。专为 UU远程 打造的显示与触控增强：手机、平板、电脑各有专属屏幕，画面铺满、字号随屏，原生触屏手势，App 资源库。Make UU Remote native on any device: a dedicated screen for every phone, tablet and computer, with native touch gestures and an App Library.
Lightweight (~1.5 MB) open-source screen annotation with click-through mode and keyboard-first shortcuts. For demos, teaching, meetings & screen recording. Windows, macOS.
A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10. Glass fences, live folders, tabs, Peek. Rust, a few MB of RAM at rest, 11 languages, portable.
Foqos allows you to lock apps behind the tap of a NFC tag or scan of a QR code. Free and open source alternative to Brick, Opal, ScreenZen, Unpluq, Scrolly, Blok and more!

A lightweight Dynamic Island for Windows. Track AI agent sessions and quotas, handle approvals, and see WeChat, QQ and email alerts. Includes synced lyrics, a file shelf, clipboard history, quick translation and to-dos. | Windows 轻量灵动岛。查看 AI Agent 会话和额度、处理审批、接收微信、QQ 和邮件提醒。支持同步歌词、文件中转、剪贴板历史、快捷翻译和待办。
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
A browser extension that lets you hide recommendations, customize the interface, and take control of your YouTube experience.

A modern platform tailored for hosting providers and enthusiasts to effortlessly interact with their servers. Seamlessly wrapping around Proxmox, Convoy is easily deployable, affordable at just $6 per node per month for commercial use, and completely free for personal and non-profit endeavors.
Hyprland-style tiling window manager for macOS: automatic dwindle (BSP) layout, 10 workspaces, keyboard-first, SIP stays on
A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows.
Coco Super Intelligence: agent skills, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. One command installs them into the tool you already use.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.
ERD Builder Pro is a database design and documentation tool for developers. Build ERDs, flowcharts, notes, and drawings — all in one workspace
Terminal-native AI coding assistant for real repositories. Inspect code, edit files, run tests, and verify changes from the CLI.

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.
